dossier.headline: A run of US sessions driven by AI chips, inflation and oil
dossier.summary: The Nasdaq hit a record on an AI chip rally in early October, then dropped 1.25% as chip stocks slid and 1.9% on a hot US CPI print. It rebounded from steep early losses mid-month and the Dow rose 1% on earnings and lower oil. The last appearance, on 26 October, had the Dow losing 653 points on oil, closing down 1.23% at 52,215.16, with the S&P 500 down 0.52% and the Nasdaq down 0.21% for a second straight weekly loss.
why_it_matters: US closes set the overnight cue for the Indian pre-open.
Chip and AI moves feed through to Indian IT sentiment.
Oil moved US indices directly in this period, linking two threads.
